970	rich, you don't need to be a poet or a writer, you don't
971	need now to deliver some moving speech with
972	tears, full of wise or deep words, nothing.
973	Something simple, simple, from the heart, sincere, even dry,
974	without feelings, without anything. Say it, speak.
975	And after, after he said all this, he says:
976	everything I am commanded to do
977	is very heavy to do. How strange.
978	You tell me: I have the easiest repair for you in the
979	world. No tzaddik gave such an easy repair to people
980	like these, HaShem have mercy, who went through what they went through.
981	Why? Why do you tell me it is so heavy?
982	Because of this, it is heavy: because it weighs so much.
983	Because of this it is heavy. It is not really heavy, it is heavy
984	because there are forces that clothe themselves in it: do everything
985	except this. Do what you want, be great
986	in Torah, be a giver of charity, be wise, be
987	rich, be successful, raise children, do what
988	you want, only do not speak with the Holy One, blessed be He.
989	And if you try, we will ruin it for you. You will feel
990	that it doesn't go well. For long periods
991	after I began to enter into this matter, I would come
992	to do hitbodedut and feel that I was burning,
993	I'm hot, I'm cold, I'm itchy, I'm annoyed, I'm bored,
